proposedChanges.new: A Stellar memo is optional **transaction-level** metadata; a classic transaction carries at most one. Types are `MEMO_TEXT` (UTF-8, up to 28 bytes), `MEMO_ID` (uint64), `MEMO_HASH` (32 bytes), and `MEMO_RETURN` (32-byte refund-reference hash).
